components.name: Steps · Vertical item
components.description: One step of a vertical sequence — order tracking, application stages, onboarding, long-form progress. Status: Complete · Current · Upcoming · Error. Marker: Dot 8 · Number 24 · Icon 24. Turn Line before off on the first step and Line after off on the last. The line after a Complete step is accent; after anything else, border/default. React: <Steps.Item status marker>.

components.name: Steps · Horizontal item
components.description: One step of a horizontal timeline — order tracking on a card, checkout stages. 160 wide; lines fill to the neighbours. Line slots keep their space when the line is hidden, so markers stay aligned. React: <Steps.Item orientation="horizontal">.

components.name: Steps
components.description: Ready-made sequences of 3, 4 or 5 Number steps. Edit each item’s status and title; for more than 5 steps show a counter (“Step 3 of 8”) instead of every step.

4.17 Steps
Where the user is in a process — order tracking, application stages, onboarding, long forms. Vertical and horizontal items (4 statuses × 3 markers, LTR and RTL — 24 each) and ready sequences of 3–5 steps. Not to be confused with 3.9 Stepper (a ± number input).
